entities.name: Anton Lehár
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antal Freiherr von Lehár was an Austrian officer of Hungarian descent, who reached the pinnacle of his service after World War I when he supported the former Emperor Charles I of Austria's attempts to retake the throne of Hungary. His brother was composer Ferenc Lehár.

entities.summary: Antal Freiherr von Lehár was an Austrian officer of Hungarian descent, who reached the pinnacle of his service after World War I when he supported the former Emperor Charles I of Austria's attempts to retake the throne of Hungary. His brother was composer Ferenc Lehár.
